x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item.body: Given an employee relations case, When a Tier 1 HR agent searches for it, Then it is not returned Given an IT administrator without HR roles, When they query sn_hr_core_case, Then no case data is visible Given a user is the subject of a case, When they view their own cases, Then the case is visible only if the HR service allows it
x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item.title: Sensitive HR cases are restricted to authorised HR roles only
